name: herdr
description: herdr is a fast, cross-platform CLI tool from herdrdev/herdr distributed as a static binary via GitHub releases.

version.description: Version of herdr to install (e.g. 'latest' or a specific tag like 'v0.7.3').

outsideOfContainer.description: Use only the external Herdr control API. Requires an explicit runtime socket-directory bind mount in devcontainer.json; does not start a local server.

containerSocketPath.description: Absolute path to the mounted host API socket inside the container when outsideOfContainer is enabled. Host source paths are configured in devcontainer.json mounts.
